title: Fast agent edits with SwiftUI hot reload
summary: Thomas Ricouard demonstrates quick edits to a SwiftUI weather app and explains how Inject and InjectionIII hot reload keep the running app in the feedback loop. The clip illustrates one small codebase rather than a general speed benchmark; an iOS team can use this setup for bounded UI experiments, then verify the accepted change with a normal build and interaction checks.
takeaway: Use hot reload to inspect small SwiftUI edits as the agent makes them, then run a normal build and interaction checks before treating the experiment as an accepted implementation.
